NBN® Plans

Bring your own modem to cut costs and minimise waste

As an nbn user who already have an nbn-compatible modem you don’t need to buy another one. Together with the onboarding package, we will provide you with comprehensive information and instructions regarding the modem configuration.  Learn more

What kind of equipment do I need?

Your equipment

Your connection type is {connectionType} so you will need:

  • a VDSL2 compatible modem which has a port at the back called DSL
  • a DSL cable (RJ11)

Your connection type is {connectionType} so you will need:

  • a router with a port at the back called WAN
  • an Ethernet cable (RJ45)

For your new fibre service you will need:

  • a router with a port at the back called WAN
  • an Ethernet cable (RJ45)

Your Wi-Fi version

For the best experience your modem/router needs to support at least Wi-Fi version 4 (also known as 802.11n) which has a typical maximum speed of up to 100 Mbps.

For the best experience your modem/router needs to support at least Wi-Fi version 5 (also known as 802.11ac) which has a typical maximum speed of up to 500 Mbps.

For the best experience your modem/router needs to support at least Wi-Fi version 6 (also known as 802.11ax) which has a typical maximum speed of up to 1000 Mbps.

The newer the better

We recommend using a modem/router that has been purchased within the last 5 years. Older equipment may have limitations or may not function with our service.

Modem Setup

If you’re already using (or have purchased) a modem/router from another NBN® provider, you may need to configure or update the settings to ensure it works with us. Either way, we can help you get all set up. Please ensure your device hasn't been locked by your previous provider. Switching NBN providers? Here's what you need to know.

 

Modem recommendations have been provided by NBN. For further information click here. It is your responsibility to ensure your self-supplied modem can connect to amaysim NBN and achieve your nbn plan speeds. Your modem/router and how it is set up in your house may affect your ability to reach the maximum speed of your plan.

What is a fibre upgrade?

Fibre upgrade allows eligible NBN fibre to the node (FTTN) and Fibre to the Curb (FTTC)  customers to upgrade to NBN's FTTP (Fibre to the Premise) – which allows for a faster and more stable internet connection to future proof your home and unlock greater speeds. The installation process takes around 2-4 weeks.

How does it work?

Choose an NBN plan

Ready to upgrade? Pick an eligible plan to suit your internet needs.

We’ll book an appointment

Once your order is placed we’ll give you all the details you need to know.

Get your fibre installed

You can keep using your current service while NBN does the installation.

Connect  and enjoy

We’ll let you know when your modem is ready to access ultrafast internet.

What are the benefits?

Near-gigabit speeds

Crank 10x faster internet than NBN 50 with a Fibre to the Premises (FTTP) connection

Quicker than ever, NBN full fibre is purpose built for a multi-device future that’s already here.

$0 upgrade  to fast fibre*

Choose an eligible high-speed amaysim NBN plan and get FREE fast fibre installation.

By future-proofing your home AI and VR, you can add to its marketability and resale value.

Consistent performance

Reliably stream silky 4K and download massive files in mere minutes – full on with full fibre.

Ideal for WFH, you can make video calls and upload documents to the cloud with minimal interruptions.

A better experience

Faster response times with less lag and lower latency on multiple smart devices are just the beginning.

For serious multiplayer gamers, it could be the difference between bragging rights and humble pie.

*Free fibre upgrade for eligible customers who sign up to eligible plans. Standard installation only.

Critical Information Summary   nbn® Key Facts Sheet

Your modem/router and how it is set up in your house may affect your ability to reach the maximum speed of your plan.

SFOA & Fair Go Policy apply, refer to our Critical Information Summaries and nbn Key Facts Sheet.

Fair Go Policy applies to all amaysim internet services. Available to selected premises.

These plans are subscription plans that do not include paper bills and require you to set up automatic payments (i.e. direct debit) via a credit, debit or charge card as the only payment method for these plans. Automatic payments from a bank account is not an option. See “Payment Information” below for more details.

Fees, charges, and cancellation

Start-up fee: There is no start-up fee for these plans.

NBN Charges: Installation fees may apply if you request a technician for set up where a self-install option is available. nbn may send you an self-installation kit. Additional fees may apply for a first time nbn connection to dwellings in new developments.

Other fees such as Missed appointment fee, Cancelled appointment fee, Subsequent installation fee and No Fault found fee may also apply.

Minimum term: You must connect for a minimum of one month. Minimum term and charging commence when nbn confirms to us that your service is operational.

Minimum total cost: Minimum total cost for each month-to-month plan is calculated as one month of the applicable plan fee.

Cancellation: You can cancel your plan at any time by notifying us. You will not receive a refund of charges paid in advance for the remainder of your payment cycle, unless otherwise set out in our agreement and subject to your consumer law rights. Once you have cancelled, you will retain access to your service until the end of your renewal period.

Payment information: You will be automatically charged via your selected credit, debit or charge card at the start of each payment cycle for recurring charges. By signing up to these plans, you are agreeing to the amaysim automatic payment provisions set out at Terms & Policies.

An electronic tax invoice will be provided after payment through email. We do not provide paper bills or invoices for these plans. You can view your Invoices and update your payment details at any time in the amaysim App or by visiting My Amaysim at myamaysim. As your payment method is required to be automatic payments in the form of direct debit from a credit, debit or charge card, there are no processing fees. For more info, go to How to pay your bill.

 

Important service and equipment information

Serviceability: Unfortunately, we cannot guarantee connection until we successfully install your service. 

Priority Assistance: We do not offer Priority Assistance. A provider who does is Telstra.

Battery back-up: We do not support battery back-up functionality for nbn services and in most cases, nbn services will not function during a power failure.

Accessibility: For information about products and services we offer for customers with different disabilities, please see: Accessibility Information.

Speed & Video Quality: Many factors affect speed and video quality such as internet traffic, your line condition, your hardware and software, the data source or destination, your location and the number of simultaneous video streams or other downloads you have running over your connection.

BYO Modem: To take up one of these plans you must bring your own modem, you acknowledge and agree that:

  • amaysim does not offer a phone service with our NBN plans, which means you won’t have access to a landline home phone service that you can use to make or receive calls or contact emergency services like 000.

  • It’s your responsibility to ensure your self-supplied modem is nbn compatible and can be used on the nbn.

  • If you have chosen the faster of our speed plans (Fast As and Superfast As) you will need to ensure that your self-supplied modem is able to deliver the faster speed to your devices. We recommend Wi Fi 6 modems for these plans. You should contact your device supplier to find out if your device will work before connecting to the nbn network.

  • amaysim will only be able to provide you with general support for your service. We won’t be able to identify or fix faults related to your self-supplied modem, you’ll need to contact the manufacturer directly.

  • nbn® reserves the right to refuse to fix a fault where it considers a modem to be the cause or to suspend a service where it considers a modem to be unsupportable or a risk to the network.

  • We're required to test the service is working but because we only offer BYO plans, we can't do these test. You will need to tell us if there are any issues with your nbn service before those issues will be rectified.

Trademark notices: nbn®, NBN Co limited and other nbn® logos and brands are trademarks of NBN Co limited and used under licence.

Customer Satisfaction Guarantee: If you are not happy with your amaysim nbn service within 30 days of connecting, you may cancel via phone or message and receive a refund your first monthly plan fees.

To claim, you’ll need to contact us prior to disconnecting or transferring your nbn and state that you are cancelling your amaysim NBN plan under the Satisfaction Guarantee policy. If you have any offers, or credits on your account that have been given to you by amaysim, they won't be refunded, exchanged or redeemable for cash when you claim.

Only available once per customer per residential address, within the first 30 days (prior to first bill). If you have previous claimed under the Satisfaction Guarantee, you may be asked to provide proof of address and move in date to show that you have changed premises since the previous claim.

None of this will affect any other rights or remedies you may have under the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth).

$10 off for your first 6 months (Standard Introductory Offer): If you sign up to an amaysim nbn plan, you will receive $10 off your plan access fee per month, for the first 6 months, and then pay the standard in-market plan fee thereafter. The offer is not available with any other offer, unless specified. The discount is forfeited if you cancel your nbn plan.

Additional Service $10 Credit: After their first 6 months, Customers who have an amaysim SIM Plan, in addition to their NBN plan, will receive a $10 discount on their nbn plan fees. for as long as they retain that active amaysim mobile service. One discount per customer. Not available with any other offer unless specified. Discount is forfeited if customer cancels their nbn plan.

Fibre Upgrade: Available to new and existing eligible amaysim customers who (unless advised otherwise) must sign up to an amaysim nbn 500, nbn 750 and nbn 1000 plan. Applies to standard install only, additional connection charges, such as such as for unforeseen works may apply. 

Installation appointments: Appointment required for service installations. The time it takes for the installation to be completed varies but it is usually completed between 2 – 4 weeks.

Wholesale speed: The nbn tier figures (e.g. NBN 1000) show the wholesale maximum network speeds available during off-peak periods. They, along with the ‘typical busy period speeds,’ do not reflect the actual speeds customers experience in their homes, which may be slower. Not all customers will reach these speeds. In some cases, the nbn tier figures and typical busy period speeds are the same or similar

NBN Equipment: Your modem/router and how it’s set up in your home may affect your ability to reach the maximum speed of your plan

Internet Speed: The actual speed you will experience at any given time will vary depending on a number of factors including plan speed, network (i.e., signal, proximity, line of sight, or congestion), location (i.e., modem placement geography, obstructions), and other factors (such as weather, hardware, software)

Landline incompatibility: amaysim NBN Home Internet does not support landlines. This means that your existing phone number will be disconnected when you sign up to our NBN service.

 

An important reminder about medical and security alarms

amaysim Home Internet does not support specialised services like Back to Base Security Alarms or Medical Alarms and we do not support back battery back. This means that many specialised services will not work during a power outage. It is important that you contact your medical or security provider to check if these services are compatible with the NBN network. You can find more information on the NBN Co website.

Medical alarms

If your current service is with another provider, we need to tell you the following

  1. We recommend you do not request disconnection of your existing service until your new amaysim nbn service is working, to help ensure you're not left without a working service.

  2. The transfer of your service is subject to validation that it can be transferred.

  3. While you have the right to transfer your service from one provider to another, there may be costs and obligations arising from a contract with your current service provider which may include early termination fees.

  4. If you need any customer support or help with faults at any time before your service is transferred to amaysim you'll need to contact your current service provider.

  5. You should contact your provider to make sure your account has been closed after your service is up and running with amaysim.

  6. We will let you know with an SMS once your service has switched to amaysim.

  7. You may notice a short interruption.

No way. You can leave us anytime without penalty. We’ll miss you but you can change or cancel your NBN plan whenever you want. You won’t find any lock-in contracts here.

Ensure that you have a compatible modem / router. After checking you address you’ll find the equipment recommendation on each speed plan.

NBN Equipment
Some homes may need specific NBN equipment like NBN conneciton or utility boxes. Don't worry! We can provide any missing equipment after your purchase.

New Development Charge
If your home has never been connected to the NBN, a $300 New Development Charge is required to be paid at checkout. This fee goes directly to NBN to offset the expenses associated with expanding the NBN infrastructure to additional locations.


NBN Technician Appointment
Sometimes an NBN Technician may have to visit your premises to do a standard NBN installation. We’ll let you know if this is the case so you can schedule an appointment.

Yes, you can change your plan speeds once your service is active. You can upgrade to faster speeds or downgrade to a slower speed to suit your needs.

Things to be aware:

  • Your address may be limited to upgrade to higher speeds. Check your address in this page to see the plan speeds that your address supports.

  • As this is a prepaid plan, we cannot offer refunds for downgrades.

No, amaysim does not support landlines. If you have a landline service connected to your existing NBN service the landline service will be disconnected when switching to amaysim NBN.
